question: What does WAIT mean in this app?
text:
AssistantDecision rules: Buy requires an upward SMA crossover, sufficient visual evidence, reviewer acceptance, and enough paper cash for one share in the analysis check. Sell or close requires a downward SMA crossover, sufficient visual evidence, reviewer acceptance, and an existing long paper position. Hold requires an existing position and no crossover. Wait requires a flat position without an upward crossover. Neither creates an order. A comparable completed-candle SMA crossover calculation must be available; missing indicator history cannot authorize an action. result.topic: What does WAIT mean in this app?
rules: Buy requires an upward SMA crossover, sufficient visual evidence, reviewer acceptance, and enough paper cash for one share in the analysis check.
Sell or close requires a downward SMA crossover, sufficient visual evidence, reviewer acceptance, and an existing long paper position.
Hold requires an existing position and no crossover. Wait requires a flat position without an upward crossover. Neither creates an order.
A comparable completed-candle SMA crossover calculation must be available; missing indicator history cannot authorize an action.
Missing, unreadable, conflicting, stale, timed-out, or reviewer-rejected evidence makes an assessment ineligible.
